sections.to: Near Guilherand-Granges, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Biol → Near Guilherand-Granges, on the way back is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.from: Near Guilherand-Granges, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Ambert → High point near Roanne is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

This High point near Roanne → Back to Route Napoléon stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
